name: Song Subdomain
body:
Associated Domain: Charm.

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the dazing touch power of the Charm domain.

Fascination (Sp)

By singing, speaking, or playing a tune, you can compel the attention of people around you. This functions as the enthrall spell. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your cleric level.

These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—songbird, 5th—deafening song bolt, 6th—music of the spheres.
